name: HungerGames
short: A weekly Hunger Games: Reaping, training challenges, live arena broadcasts and Wondercoin sponsorship.
description: Every Sunday Hana draws tributes and opens volunteer seats (with one swap request per volunteer). Monday, tributes play four timed training challenges in public threads plus a crowd-judged interview, which set their stats and a 1-12 Training Score. Tuesday to Friday at 7 PM Pacific the arena is broadcast live in scene cards that update every few minutes (about 30 minutes a night, the Feast night 45), with sponsors credited when their parachute saves someone, then the cannons sound one by one and a fresh arena board lands at the bottom of the channel. Saturday's Crowning gets a Victor banner and a recap card. Fights, hazards, alliances and the Feast are weighted by stats, plans and sponsored items. Saturday is the Finale and the Crowning. Spectators sponsor tributes with Wondercoins; most of the spend is burned and the Victor gets a cut.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per member, Hunger Games totals (editions played, wins, kills, falls, best score, times drafted or volunteered, parachutes sent and coins spent) and whether they opted out of the draft. During an edition it also keeps tributes' training results, interview answers and who sponsored or cheered whom. Member totals are deleted on a Red data-deletion request and Hall of Victors entries are anonymised.
install_msg: Open `.hg admin` (Staff, Moderators or Manage Server) to check the channel and roles, set a test channel, then run a test from the Run tab. Turn the Games on in Setup when ready: the first Reaping starts the next Sunday at 10 AM Pacific. Hana needs Send Messages, Embed Links, Attach Files (the Victor banner and Fallen wall; without it she posts text only), Manage Messages (pins), Create Public Threads and Send Messages in Threads in the Hunger Games channel, and Manage Roles above the ping and Victor roles.
